_note: Hand-set par values, for rooms where the computed one asks for something no player would reasonably know. Deliberately manual: the same surface reasoning would wrongly catch rooms players genuinely have memorised, so each of these is a judgement rather than a rule.

East Aqueduct Quicksand Room.why: Separated from West Aqueduct Quicksand Room only by enemy count, 6 against 7 of the same enemy. Nobody knows that by heart.

West Aqueduct Quicksand Room.why: Separated from East Aqueduct Quicksand Room only by enemy count, 7 against 6 of the same enemy. Nobody knows that by heart.

Purple Farming Room.why: Despite being technically unique from other 1-tile 1-entrance rooms, it's so similar that it's at least par 2 instead of par 1
